notes.title: 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
Thank you all for coming along for this Early Access journey with us! We really appreciate all of your feedback over the past year and a half, and we're thrilled to share this 1.0 build with you all!



[h1]1.0.0[/h1]

[h3]FEATURES/CONTENT:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Voiced character dialog!
[*] Lots of new story content.
[*] New endgame featuring a new level and boss fight.
[*] Added controller rumble support when you take damage.
[/list]

[h3]CHANGES/IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tight Boost Weapon Booster upgrades now increase damage amount with each level, instead of reducing required Tight Boosts.
[*] Mission finished dialogs have more variety.
[*] Defeating bosses triggers new dialogs for each character and boss type.
[*] Tight Boost Damage Charger is extended if an additional Tight Boost happens while it's active.
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Roll magnet works more reliably now, especially in Act 3.
[*] Charaters no longer react as if Swarm are hitting them when they collide with the environment.
[*] Fixed bug where characters would say dialog lines referring to cursed choices, even when they aren't active.
[*] Fixed weapon sounds playing forever if you were charging a weapon at the end of a level.
[*] Fixed critical hit chance on Tight Boost Damage Charger.
[*] Fixed some issues with character unlocking.
[*] Fixed some issues with steam deck audio and headphones.
[*] Fixed issue with roll magnet not working at times.
[*] Added tooltips for mod icons on game over screen.
[*] Fix for end game sequence not playing in some cases.
[*] Fix for post[*]victory hangar dialogs not playing properly.
[*] Fix for ? node rewards not applying to some weapons and missile drones.
[*] Disable "reroll" button for a moment when upgrades screen pops up to make it harder to select accidentally.
[*] Fix for "boost" controller trigger image not showing properly in tutorial.
[*] Various UI fixes and improvements.
[*] Fixes for VO/text mismatches.
[*] Fix for lockup when pausing in the map screen.
[*] Fixed bug where boss music continued into map screen.
[*] Fix for endgame in final boss fight triggering improperly when one of the two bosses is destroyed.
[/list]

Please let us know what you think in the comments! We can't promise a particular cadence for updates at this point, but we'll be listening to feedback!

notes.title: 0.73.3 Released.
notes.content:
[b]Thank you[/b] for being part of the Whisker Squadron community! Your support means the world to us, and we’re excited to continue making the game even better. We hope you enjoy this update, and stay tuned for more exciting news as we move closer to our 1.0 launch! You might spot some new dialogue as we prepare for recording sessions with our voice actors. We plan to announce our cast in the new year alongside some other exciting news!

[h3]Whisker Squadron: Survivor Holiday Sale[/h3]
Get your copy of Whisker Squadron: Survivor at the best price for a while! From December 19th to January 1st, our holiday sale on Steam will let you pick up the game for yourself (or for a friend)!

[b]Note: In this update, you may notice that the story progression that happens in the hangar starts back at the beginning with this update. We've updated the game's narrative significantly and this was a necessary change to avoid breaking certain things, but it may look a little confusing if you are playing on an old save.[/b]

[h3]NEW FEATURES/CONTENT:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added lots of new story content and dialog[/b] (primarily updates to the first part of Olivia's story). Get ready to dive deeper into Olivia's world and uncover more twists and turns in her journey.
[*] [b]"?" nodes now give random rewards[/b]. The thrill of uncertainty is back! Who knows what you’ll uncover as you explore.
[*] [b]Added a new "progress meter" system[/b] for several unlocks. Now you can track your progress in real-time and celebrate those milestones as you unlock new features.
[*] [b]Rerolls are back![/b] You can reroll once per level up - for a VP cost. If the upgrades aren’t to your liking, try your luck again and see what you get next.
[/list]

[h3]CHANGES/IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Moved "Invert Y" option[/b] to default options screen to make it easier to find. Now, it’s more accessible.
[*] [b]Changed how new characters are unlocked[/b]. The process is now smoother and more rewarding, so you can unlock characters with ease.
[*] [b]Adjusted VP prices[/b] for most perks. We’ve fine-tuned the prices to give you better access to perks without breaking the bank.
[*] [b]Reduced maximum effect of Longevity Enhancer[/b] to 50%. This change will keep things balanced while still allowing you to enjoy the benefits of the Longevity Enhancer.
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that prevented [b]"Scrap limit" challenge[/b] from properly unlocking.
[*] Fixed bugs that prevented unlocking the [b]Pulse Laser[/b].
[*] Fixed bug where [b]boss chunks[/b] could damage the ship.
[*] Fixed bug with [b]Combo Missile Booster[/b] where it could trigger multiple times per zone.
[*] Fixed a visual FX bug related to [b]invincibility powerup[/b] that made your ship disappear.
[/list]

[h3]UPCOMING[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Complete story[/b] that progresses throughout each run. Look forward to even more story content that keeps you hooked as you advance.
[*] [b]VO for conversations during the action[/b]. We’re adding voiceovers to make in-game dialogue more dynamic and immersive.
[*] [b]Lots of balance and tuning[/b] (especially in act 3). Expect even more fine-tuning to ensure the game remains challenging and enjoyable.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.72.1 Released.
notes.content:
Meowdy, fellow pilots! Version 0.72.1 is live, and we’ve made some substantial changes to map progression and balancing while also finding time to add some additional items.

[h3]Map Updates[/h3]
Let’s start from the top.  We got a lot of feedback asking for more substantial options along the map pathways.  

Our amazing mechanic Petey has now added a significant number of additions to his shop.  Now, when you visit one of his nodes you can have some of these options appear;
[list]
[*] Max upgrade: either an item you currently own or a random unowned one
[*] Max upgrade your Primary or Secondary Weapon
[*] Unlock revive or rerolls for your current run
[*] Unlock a new Primary Weapon
[*] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/bc754c39b06ecf45d230d41819f30f353505fec8.png[/img]

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
After maxing out your Primary Weapon level in a run, the next time you meet Petey, he’ll offer one of 3 new weapons. You can also level these up even further during a run!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/51384f51a030ca06de8cc67cb3a8fe550add8a56.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/42f75ff5d95022bc63516fcfdcaabd405f63bea8.gif[/img]

[h3]Cursed Choices[/h3]
We know that when Cursed Choices came out, we got a lot of mixed feedback, but it was clear that changes were needed. We continued to tweak and work on them update after update, listening to feedback along the way. With this update, we are excited to announce another change to help Cursed Choices feel significantly more exciting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/d6f63095b0ecd848037b6a90bfcfb9dfc7fc43bc.png[/img]
Now, each curse lasts a set number of rounds and offers a new item in exchange for picking them that last for the duration of your run.  These items range from powerful augments to items that the Swarm can drop when defeated.


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed a handful of issues, most notably some related to Tight Boosts.

See full patch notes below!
—-
THANK YOU for your support! Here's what's new in this update:

0.72.1
NEW FEATURES/CONTENT:
- Zones with environmental hazards now give extra scrap
- Redesigned Cursed Choice node with randomized rewards and modified curses.
- Added new pickups as rewards for cursed choices including:
	- Overcharge (unlimited energy for a short time)
	- Super Missile (gives your a super-charged missile)
	- Invincibility (makes you invincible for a time)
- Redesigned Petey Node with several upgrade possibilities including:
	- Get random unowned item at max level
	- Max-out random owned item
	- Max out primary or secondary weapon
	- Get dual laser cannon
	- Get dual gatling gun
	- Get dual burst-blaster

CHANGES/IMPROVEMENTS:
- Increased energy amounts for Energy Absorber augmentation
- Tight Boost Weapon Booster augmentation now requires fewer tight boosts
- Updates and additions to Olivia and Max in-run barks (meows)
- Campaign map description improvements
- Rebalanced enemy health and damage
- Adjusted some enemy speeds at certain distances
- Disabled a bugged challenge

BUG FIXES:
- Fixed Combo Shooter augmentation bug
- Fixed pause screen bug
- Fixed collision issue with destroyed enemy parts
- Fixed issue with energy text popups
- Fixed description of Dagger ship
- Fixed issue where you could boost past Sky Crawler larva

notes.title: 0.71.1 Released.
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready for a game-changing update! [/h2]
[h3]🚀 We’re excited to unveil Version 0.71.1, packed with thrilling new features, game enhancements, and crucial bug fixes. Here’s what’s in store:[/h3]

[h3]New Items[/h3]
We've added a variety of powerful new items to the game, including enhancements for deflection, Tight Boosting, and energy management. You'll also find new ways to increase your missile and weapon damage, as well as a new Bomb Drone that brings explosive power to your arsenal.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/bdbb3d06aedc3f6c279d5405b859b4ac0a8d9acd.png[/img]

[h3]Improved Gameplay[/h3]
Leveling up has been refined for a smoother experience, and several existing items have received significant improvements. Plus, item tooltips are now available in the UI, giving you quick access to important information during gameplay.

To make things even better, we've introduced a new Spin Dodge move, allowing for greater lateral maneuverability during intense moments. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/552253dff797fdc9a8d05cbe886fbe0f86ddaf32.gif[/img]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Finally, we've squashed some pesky bugs, ensuring smoother gameplay and addressing issues with enemy homing missiles, the Energy Recharge Factor, and more.

These are just the highlights—be sure to check out the full patch notes below for a detailed breakdown of all the changes.

notes.title: 0.70 Released.
notes.content:
Thank you for all of the feedback on campaign mode. We've been hard at work and are so excited for this update! 

[h3]Nexus Station Updates[/h3]
Discover new destructible objects and pattern variety in Nexus Station, adding a fresh twist to your exploration. Get ready to experience the station like never before with these exciting new elements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/c3a07488457ca5cb61ebbd5870249e19733b6873.gif[/img]


[h3]Balanced Battles[/h3]
We've reworked combat and enemies to make gameplay more fun and engaging. Lower enemy health in Acts 2 and 3 and more consistent Action Zones ensure fairer fights, and enemy spawning has been adjusted.

[h3]Gatling Gun and Burst Blaster Improvements[/h3]
Combat just got a major upgrade! Enjoy increased damage and damage upgrades for the Gatling Gun and Burst Blaster.

[h3]And more![/h3]
Plus, enjoy enhanced map music and sound effects for a richer experience. You can now pause the game on the map screen to tweak settings or exit back to the main menu. Jump back in and see what's new!

notes.content:
Hey all, we've been very busy since the Campaign Mode launch! We've been reading all of your feedback and thinking about next steps for the game. To get things started, here are some quality-of-life updates for you.

[*] Fixed issue where roll deflector would miss projectiles after a long chain of deflections.
[*] Made Roll Deflector and Spin Block "extension time" more consistent.

[h2]ROADMAP[/h2]
Thanks for all of your amazing feedback since our Campaign Mode launch!
Our creative director Aaron wrote up a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2140100/discussions/0/4415298185446041541/]roadmap post [/url]on the forums detailing what's coming next for the game and sharing some thoughts on on the Campaign Mode update went. We'd love your feedback!

And as always, we'd love your feedback on the public beta branch if you'd like to get the earliest peek at what's in the pipeline for the next update.

Thanks!
-The Flippfly team.

notes.title: 0.68.7 Released.
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Campaign Mode![/h1]

This major update brings a three act campaign that features new characters, deeper narrative about the world of Whisker Squadron, new enemies, and new and improved mechanics!

[previewyoutube=dxGs-J8RDjE;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out the full patch notes below!

[h2]NEW FEATURES/CONTENT: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Campaign mode! We have redesigned the overall experience of the game to include a campaign that includes a map with a choice of paths. Rather than choosing your level at the start, a campaign has a map that includes a random selection of worlds along your journey.
Every campaign will include a variety of environments, and increasingly difficult combat encounters culminating in a boss fight at the end of each of the 3 acts.
This redesign includes major new features including:
[list]
 [*] 2 shops with new characters you can visit for upgrades.
 [*] The beginnings of a new and deeper narrative.
 [*] Three acts, with a miniboss fight at the end of each.
[/list]
[*] New enemies: Plasma Pursuer, Pulse Wave Caster, Missile Tank, Phaser, Bombardier, Gatling Defender, Laser Pinwheel, Dart, Disco Ball, Spikehead Stunner.
[*] New "Wave based" spawning system for enemies. Makes speed runs possible and reduces "dead zones" in combat.
[*] There is now a default "spin block" on the A/D (or shoulder buttons). This replaces the old tilt function. 
[*] Spinning while turning will give you a little boost in your turn direction. As a treat.
[*] Added support for 3 save slots.
[*] Ross and Max are now unlocked as part of the story.
[*] There's now a countdown meter underneath the combo indicator.
[*] Shortened intro animation for every Action Zone except the first in each act.
[*] New intro cutscene.
[/list]
[h2]CHANGES/IMPROVEMENTS: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Gatling gun energy per shot reduced a bit.
[*] Combos now unlock on run 3 with a standalone tutorial.
[*] Redesigned UI for hangar.
[*] Camera is a bit higher relative to ship so it's easier to see targets in front of ship.
[*] Laser Cannon, Multi-Missile launcher, and Crater Bomb upgrades have increased damage.
[*] Lots of enemy/combat tuning and improvements:
[list]
  [*] Enemies have new artwork and give more VP in later acts.
  [*] Enemy homing missiles now have a chance to drop a missile pickup when destroyed.
  [*] Improved enemy outlines and enhanced enemy visibility.
  [*] Enemies and enemy attacks are more visible and are a bit more difficult.
  [*] "Enhanced" enemies will appear with a special material, with more health.
[/list]
[*] Pierced Shot Healing will only appear if you have a weapon with piercing.

notes.title: Announcement: Campaign Mode Incoming June 19th.
notes.content:
Today we’re excited to announce the introduction of a new “Campaign mode” for Whisker Squadron: Survivor, launching on June 19th.

This is the most significant update to the game so far, and touches basically every aspect of the game’s design. I’m going to give an overview of what’s changed and why, and talk a bit about what’s next.

[h2]Campaign Mode Overview[/h2]
Ever since the game’s launch in Early Access last August, there’s been one throughline in the feedback we’ve seen: You all like what’s here, but want *more*. More variety in the environments, more choices, more enemies.

So first and foremost, we’re combining the existing level content into one unified campaign. This campaign spans (currently) 3 acts, each consisting of a generated map like the one below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/af60b0f36176254faaf7d4c71809a65b086a275d.png[/img]


This map contains “Action Zones” as well as upgrade shops, story moments, and “cursed choices”. Each act ends with an epic miniboss fight.

Act 1 takes place in Nexus Station. Act 2 is the area formerly called Neonfall (more on that later!), and Act 3 is in Translink City.

Additionally, each of these areas has a *lot* more variety within it.

[h2]The Game Has A Story Now![/h2]

We’ve been busy writing the underpinnings of a story for the Whisker Squadron universe, and it’s finally represented in the game with this update. You’ll learn about the origin story for Whisker Squadron, Olivia, and the other characters.

This is still an action game at heart, but this update will give some context to why you’re fighting these bugs, and the corporation (A.R.E.S) that created them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/db50f8bfd690936982bdd1b8df4c4b5df62ec1d8.png[/img]

[h2]Other Major Features and Changes[/h2]

We’ve made a myriad of other gameplay changes both large and small with this update - here’s an overview of the biggest ones:

[h3]Cursed Choices[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/330247db0097ed6d76cfef1ed85ab8d49153457f.gif[/img]

Cursed choices were previously a “mandatory” feature that happened when you leveled up 10 times. We heard your feedback on this design loud and clear!  In this update, Cursed Choices are an optional node on the map. Additionally we’re in the process of redesigning these to feel more rewarding. These should feel like an interesting “push your luck” choice, and not a punishment.

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]

We’ve nearly doubled the number of enemies in the game with this update. Each act features its own unique enemies, adding a lot of new gameplay variety that will take you awhile to master!

[h3]Blocking As A Default Mechanic[/h3]

In the current version of the game, it’s possible to tilt your ship (which makes you turn a bit faster), and a double-tap of the tilt button actives a spin, which by default does nothing.

With this update, we’ve replaced the ability to tilt your ship with a built in spin-block, which activates with a single click. This might take a bit of getting used to, but it’s allowed us to design a much more interesting and varied set of enemy mechanics, and we feel makes the game’s controls more accessible and intuitive.

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
We've also redesigned the main menu and hangar screens to help support this campaign change, and made a myriad of other quality of life changes, which we'll list in full on the June 19th release.

[h3]We need Beta Testers![/h3]
Want to get an early peek at this update? Jump in the public beta branch, and then [url=discord.gg/flippfly]join the Discord [/url]or use the in-game feedback form to let us know what you think!

notes.title: 0.67.3 Released
notes.content:
Hey friends, the team has been working super hard on a major new content update!
One of the most requested features for this series is boss fights.

We have some BIG plans for end stage bosses coming soon, but in the meantime, we decided to redesign the "Elite" enemies in the game and turn them into epic miniboss fights.

Here's how it works: 
There are (currently) 4 possible elites that will spawn in zone 5. They are the [b]only[/b] thing in that zone, and we've done our best to make it feel really cinematic. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/ab12e63805c1ac14da28514676afeee58ec2d144.gif[/img]

There's even a mysterious "The Swarm" character speaking through them. What is it saying??
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43364174/83fc3281e881dc32dfd968f028885d2d18a8b77f.png[/img]

We'll be refining this system in the coming months and adding additional Elites.

notes.title: Thanks for a great launch! We're just getting started.
notes.content:
Hey all, first of all, we just want to say THANK YOU for an incredible launch. The team of 9 over here at Flippfly couldn't be more excited to be working on this game!

We've been reading all of your reviews, your feedback surveys (hundreds of them!) discussion forum comments, Discord chats, and watching your videos and livestreams.

We are seeing a few clear patterns in feedback:
1. You like what's here and you're looking forward to more content and variety in the game.
2. We've got some balance issues with weapons and items to work on.
3. We've got quite a few bugs and quality-of-life issues to work on too.

[b]Here's What's Next[/b]
We are planning to release new builds every two weeks for now.

This upcoming first patch (Dropping around Sep 13) will primarily deal with quality-of-life issues, bugs, and item balance. We're making the Pulse Laser pack more punch, balancing out the Gatling gun a bit, fixing all the achievement and Mod bugs, and making mods give more VP. We're also fixing about two dozen bugs, and making the color scheme in Nexus City a bit more readable and easy on the eyes.

For the second update, our artist Jin and programmer/designer Dayne are in the home stretch on a new world. We're also working on "twitch plays" integration so Twitch viewers can pick upgrades, and even more quality-of-life updates.

Beyond that, we're looking into ways to add more variety and surprise to the core game loop - exciting new items and choices that can change your run in fundamental ways.

And of course, there will be more ships, pilots, and weapons! We're also looking into the possibility of mod support, and even investigating VO for characters. No promises, though!

Keep the feedback coming, and thanks again for your support! What are the "dream features" you'd love to see in this game?
